description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaKeysClientMock' for the 'IMediaKeysClient' interface, used for testing media key handling in the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for license request, renewal, and key status change events.

classes.name: MediaKeysClientMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeysClient interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Mock method to simulate handling of license requests with session ID, message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Mock method to simulate handling of license renewal messages.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Mock method to simulate handling of key status changes.
